contract.title: D1 dynamic link rate round-5 cold-start review (commit 5d9ad9b)
contract.goal: Review exact commit 5d9ad9b3a4e3ce349e39dc5dbabf02a4fe5aa6d0 on branch codex/20260819-d1-dynamic-rate. Round-4 (commit 2e88099) REQUEST_CHANGES findings to re-verify, all claimed fixed: (F2-RACE) the GSL MCS wait must run the deadline sweep unconditionally after yield timeout|wake, so a same-timestamp poke can no longer skip an exact-deadline expiry -- verify unconditional sweeps in UplinkServer._run and DownlinkServer._run plus the adversarial same-time-wake regression. (F3) stop-time pending settlement must use stop_time >= pkt.deadline (inclusive) -- verify the comparator and the deadline==horizon regression. (F4) mcs_zero_rate_holds must only count when geometry AND GE are up (MCS is the actual blocker): verify _gsl_wait_until and _transmit attribution plus the GE+zero-rate overlap regression. (F5) constant-rate shared GSL must pre-gate geometry/GE before dequeue (uplink geometry+GE, downlink GE), with recovery timers in the constant wait paths, so a gated head cannot pin the shared server; verify the constant uplink/downlink shared-server regressions and the updated test_transmit_retirement.py invariants (queue-level retirement race). (F1-R, independent) _fire_interrupt must immediately release a queue-gated retiring head at the hard retirement deadline instead of waiting for the next _evaluate_handover tick; verify the interrupt-side cleanup and the non-tick retire_at regression. Also confirm no regression in legacy RF/MCS equivalence, receipt counters, and overall test adequacy. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES with FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, exact path/line evidence, concrete reproduction conditions, severity and open_items. Do not modify code.
acceptance: Explicit re-check of F2-RACE/F3/F4/F5/F1-R with line evidence
Every major finding has exact evidence and reproduction condition
requiredEvidence: Exact commit-bound GitHub paths and line references

Explicit verdict on inclusive pending settlement and deadline==horizon regression
Explicit verdict on MCS attribution excluding geometry/GE
Explicit verdict on constant-rate GSL pre-dequeue gating and shared-server regressions
Explicit verdict on _fire_interrupt queue-level retirement cleanup
